book.name: 1 Korintofɔ
book.title: Ɔwʋlʋ́ Gyankpapʋá Paulo Lɔ́wanlɩ́n Sɩ́sɩ́ Korintofɔ

content: Bahɩ́ɛ́ bɛbláa mɩ bɛɛ, mlɩtɔ akʋ bʋdɛ atsɩ mʋ́a ayin asʋ́n wa. Ɔmátɔ́fɔ kʋ́ráá bʋmɛdɛ́ mʋ́ odu bwɛ. Mlɩtɔ ɔkʋ mʋ́ kʋ́ráá laswɩ́ɩ́ mʋ sɩ mʋ ka,
ɩbʋ mlɩ ansigyí! Ɩma mlɩ awɩrɛhɔ. Pɛ́lɩ mɛdɛ́ mlɩ, mɛ́nɩ mlégya ɔhá ánfɩ odu lɛ́ mlɩ ɔpasuatɔ.
Ɩ́nɩá mlɩmɛ́dɛ́ mɩ́ wúun ó á, mbʋ mlɩtɔ ɔŋɛ́tɔ́. Nahá ɔhá ánfɩ ɔbʋ tsiátɔ́ anfɩ odu ɩpɔ́n dodoodo, fɛ́ mbʋ ɩnʋ.
Mlɩtɩ ɔpasua ámʋ fia anɩ Wíe Yesu Kristo dátɔ́. Nétsiá mlɩtɔ ɔŋɛ́tɔ́, anɩ Wíe Yesu Kristo túmi ɛ́ ibétsiá mlɩtɔ.
Ɩnʋ á, mlɩpʋ mʋ wa Ɔbʋnsám ɩbɩtɔ, oyinta mʋ ɔyʋlʋ́ʋ, mɛ́nɩ Bulu ɔbɔ́hɔ mʋ ɔkláa nkpa anɩ Wíe Yesu ɔbákɛ amʋ.
Kpaalɩ mlɩdɛ́ ɩwɩ tsu. Mlɩméyín ánɩ́ bodobodotu-afá kpalobí tɛ́há bodobodo amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ itotú?

Ɩ́nɩ sʋ mlɩlɛ lalahɛ ɔbwɛpʋ́ anfɩ mlɩtɔ, mɛ́nɩ mlɩ ɩwɩ bɛ́tɩn fɛ́ bodobodoá bʋmɔwa afá mʋ́tɔ́, tsúfɛ́ alɩ́ mlɩhɩ́ɛ́ mlɩgyí nɩ́. Megyí bodobodoá bʋmɔwa afá mʋ́tɔ́, imotu bʋtɔpʋ́gyí Katsʋn Nkɛ? Bamɔ́ anɩ Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn Nkɛtɔ Okúfabi, ogyi Kristo amʋ, lɛ́ anɩ nwunsʋ mbusuo há anɩ dodoodo.
Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩha apʋ bodobodoá imotu, igyi ɩwɩtɩ́ɩn mʋ́a ɔnɔkwalɩwa gyi Katsʋn Nkɛ ámʋ. Mlɩmáha apʋ bodobodoá ɩlatú, igyi tsiátɔ́ laláhɛ mʋ́a lakpan gyi mʋ́.
Nɔwanlɩ́n wá ɔwʋlʋ́ kʋá nɔpʋsɩ́sɩ́ mlɩtɔ mbɛ́ɛ, mlɩmápʋ mbʋa atɔpʋ́ gyi mba.
Megyí ɔyɩ́tɔ́ mbʋa atɔpʋ́, ɔnsɩpɛ awapʋ́, awikplu ntɛ́ɛ ɩkpɩ atswɛ́pʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n nɛblɩ́. Mʋ́mʋ́ tɛkɩ mlɛ́dalɩ ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ asa mlɩmɔ́ɔwa amʋ́ mba nɩ́.

Tɔ́á nɔwanlɩ́n sɩ́sɩ́ mlɩ gyí, mlɩmápʋ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ Okristoyin mʋgyi, támɛ ɔtɔtɔ́ mbʋa ntɛ́ɛ ɔbʋ ɔnsɩ́pɛ, ɔtɔtswɛ ɩkpɩ, otesíá mʋ aba, ɔtɔbʋ́ ntá ntɛ́ɛ otowí atɔ́ gyi mba. Mlɩa ɔhá ámʋ nyɔ mlɩmáwa ɩbɩ gyi atɔ́ kʋ́ráá.
Ntɔ sʋ́ négyi ahá ánɩ́ bʋma ɔpasua ámʋtɔ asʋ́n? Megyí ahá ánɩ́ bʋbʋ mʋ́tɔ́, bʋdɛ lakpan ánfɩ odu bwɛ mboún asʋ́n lehián ánɩ́ mlégyi?
Bulu obégyi ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋma ɔpasua ámʋtɔ ámʋ mʋ́ asʋ́n. Támɛ bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋtɔ bɛɛ, “Mlɩ mʋ́ mlɩgya lalahɛ ɔbwɛpʋ́ lɛ mlɩtɔ.”
